hooks.command: content=$(cat /home/user/ubermensch/memory/README.md 2>/dev/null || echo '(memory/README.md not found)'); jq -n --arg c "$content" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("[auto-injected from memory/README.md — read relevant memory/*.md files before substantive work. See CLAUDE.md for protocol.]\n\n" + $c)}}'

input=$(cat); echo "$input" | jq -e '.stop_hook_active == true' >/dev/null 2>&1 || jq -n '{decision:"block",reason:"[memory protocol] Before stopping, review this session for durable facts/decisions/gotchas worth appending to memory/{project,user,decisions,gotchas}.md per /home/user/ubermensch/CLAUDE.md. If something qualifies (stated preference, non-obvious decision, gotcha, or user correction), append a dated note. If nothing qualifies, acknowledge briefly and stop again — this reminder fires only once per stop cycle."}'
